teaser: You snap the clasp shut on a case before the thought that filled it has finished forming. Life path 1 asks for a life that starts things and stands behind them without flinching. ISFP builds a life by feel, by hand, by what looks right before it can be explained in words. Crossed, this is someone who leads without ever sounding like a leader — the one who starts a business out of a hobby, who straightens a crooked frame on the wall before correcting anyone's grammar. The tension sits quietly underneath: how much of a vision gets built alone, and how much of a self gets handed to no one at all.
excerpt: The apartment gets rearranged without a vote, a shelf shifted to where the light falls better, and it stays there after.
